description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart showing the distribution of “Task Type” aggregated over both agencies, with 3 slices in total. The largest slice is labeled “Article generation (83.1%)” and is colored salmon/red, occupying most of the ring; a smaller slice labeled “Headline generation (12.8%)” is colored pale yellow; and the smallest slice labeled “Article editing (4.1%)” is colored light blue. The percentages are written directly with the slice labels positioned outside the ring, and there is no separate legend. The center of the donut contains the title text “Task Type,” and no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized beyond its relative size.
